analytics.name: Analytic 1890
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a process performing rapid, bulk deletion or overwrite of files across multiple Industrial Control System (ICS)-relevant directories within a short time window, by a process not associated with documented data retention management, correlated with a system crash shortly after. Documented in CaddyWiper, deployed via GPO alongside Industroyer2. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: Allowlist of backup/archival/retention management tools authorized to perform bulk file operations.
File count threshold across monitored directories that distinguishes bulk destruction from routine cleanup.
Time window over which bulk deletion activity is measured.
IP allowlist of workstations authorized to issue memory erase commands.
Time window after bulk deletion within which a system crash is considered part of the same destructive event.
